newsitem.title: FRANCE: Yemen postpones wheat, flour tenders to Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: Yemen postpones wheat, flour tenders to Jan 14.

text.p: Yemen has postponed a tender for soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour initially scheduled for January 7 until January 14, grain traders said on Thursday.
Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of European or U.S. soft wheat flour for shipment by June.
Within the EU Yemen is seeking French, Dutch, German or Belgian flour.
It also seeks 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between June and August.
